text: By the late 1800s, the Fort Worth Stockyards had become one of America's most important livestock trading centers.
Railroads transformed Fort Worth into the gateway of the cattle industry, earning the city its legendary reputation as Cowtown.
For generations, millions of cattle passed through these historic grounds, helping shape the economy of Texas and the American West.
In the early twentieth century, the Armour Building was constructed to serve Armour and Company, one of the nation's largest meatpacking operations.
Built with remarkable craftsmanship and designed to support the thriving livestock industry, the building became an enduring symbol of the Stockyards' industrial legacy.

Even more remarkably, many of the craftsmen whose families originally laid the building's brick generations ago returned decades later to assist in its careful reconstruction during U.S. Energy's renovation.
Helping preserve an important piece of Fort Worth history.
Throughout the renovation, preserving the building's historic character remained a guiding principle.
One of its most distinctive architectural features, the original white structural beams, remain exactly as they were when the building was first constructed.
They continue to tell the story of the craftsmanship that has endured for more than a century.

Today, the Armour Building also features a state-of-the-art fitness center with a dedicated personal trainer, welcoming employees of both the Armour Building and U.S. Energy, along with members of the Fort Worth Police Department.
Today, the Armour Building stands as the proud home of U.S. Energy Development Corporation, a place where history and innovation come together.
More than simply an office, this headquarters serves as a destination for investors, partners, and clients visiting one of Texas' most iconic landmarks.
Elegant conference rooms and versatile event spaces create an environment where relationships are built, ideas are shared, and opportunities take shape.
As we continue growing, this remarkable building reflects who we are: honoring our heritage while investing boldly in the future.
We believe this headquarters is more than a workplace. It is a beacon that welcomes clients, inspires employees, and positions U.S. Energy for continued success for generations to come.
